subject.title: feat: Cron job tags/categories for organization and filtering

question: Should cron organization use freeform user tags, a typed purpose/category/display contract, or a narrower reminder/system metadata model?
rationale: The missing capability crosses persisted cron state, Gateway protocol validation, service filtering, CLI output, Control UI state, docs, and possibly bulk operations, so automation should not choose the durable API semantics alone.

options.title: Shared typed contract
options.body: Define an owner-reviewed purpose/category/display metadata shape first, then expose tags or labels through that contract where appropriate.

options.title: Freeform tags first
options.body: Add optional string tags directly to cron jobs and support tag-aware list/filter behavior across API, CLI, and UI.

options.title: No schema change
options.body: Keep name prefixes and description/search as the workaround, accepting that structured filtering and bulk operations remain unsupported.

recommendation.title: Shared typed contract
recommendation.body: Define an owner-reviewed purpose/category/display metadata shape first, then expose tags or labels through that contract where appropriate.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the closest explicit API/protocol design signal on the related opaque cron metadata PR.
